description: Assam CM inaugurates new Legislative Assembly Secretariat and launches AI platform ALISA. The move aims to modernise legislative processes and improve governance in Assam.
body_lead: Assam CM inaugurates new Assam Legislative Assembly Secretariat building, launches AI platform ‘ALISA’ Assam CM inaugurates new Legislative Assembly Secretariat and launches AI platform ALISA. The move aims to modernise legislative processes and improve governance in Assam. Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Monday, February 16, inaugurated the new Secretariat building of the Assam Legislative Assembly, along with a state-of-the-art Digital Museum and an AI-powered digital platform titled ‘ALISA: AI for Legislative Intelligence System of Assam’.
